title: Oracle Admin I
description: Oracle Admin I — a live, one-on-one 4-week course where you install and configure Oracle database instances and finish with real, show-able work.
detailParagraphs: Over roughly 4 weeks, this Oracle Admin I course gets you doing real work early. Oracle is the database engine behind a huge share of banking, ERP and enterprise systems, and administering it well is a specialised, well-paid skill.
By working through real exercises you’ll install and configure Oracle database instances, tune queries and monitor performance, and build the judgement that only comes from practice.
Because it’s taught live and personally, questions get answered the moment they come up.
keyPoints: Install and configure Oracle database instances
Run backup and recovery with RMAN

contentSections.heading: Architecture & Installation
paragraphs: How an Oracle instance is structured — memory, processes, storage — and a clean install from scratch.

contentSections.heading: Users, Roles & Security
paragraphs: Creating schemas, granting privileges, and locking the database down the way real admins do.

contentSections.heading: Storage & Tablespaces
paragraphs: Managing datafiles, tablespaces and undo so the database stays healthy as data grows.

contentSections.heading: Backup & Recovery
paragraphs: RMAN backups, restore scenarios and the recovery drills every DBA is expected to know.

contentSections.heading: Performance & Monitoring
paragraphs: Reading AWR reports, spotting slow SQL and keeping the instance responsive under load.

title: SQL
description: SQL — a live, one-on-one 6-week course where you write queries from simple SELECTs to multi-table joins and finish with real, show-able work.
detailParagraphs: Over roughly 6 weeks, this SQL course gets you doing real work early. Almost every application stores its data in a database, so being fluent in querying and designing one is a foundational skill across tech.
Expect to spend most of your time actually doing the work — you’ll use indexes to speed things up and design normalised schemas along the way.
Every session is one-on-one, so the pace bends to you — not to a class average.
keyPoints: Write queries from simple SELECTs to multi-table joins
Use indexes to speed things up

title: SAP FICO
description: SAP FICO — a live, one-on-one 2-month course where you record journal entries and ledgers and finish with real, show-able work.
detailParagraphs: Every business needs its books kept and its taxes filed correctly, which keeps skilled accounting staff in steady demand across India. This 2-month SAP FICO programme takes you from the basics to being genuinely useful.
By working through real exercises you’ll generate financial statements in accounting software, reconcile accounts, and build the judgement that only comes from practice.
You finish with practical work you can show an employer, not just a certificate.
